bee_activity_warning.message: Rainfall significantly suppresses bee flight and reduces pollination efficiency.

before: Coordinate bee hive placement timing if rain is forecast.
Delay fungicide or spray operations if heavy rain is imminent.
Ensure proper orchard drainage to prevent standing water.
during: Avoid orchard traffic to reduce soil compaction.
Secure bee hives if wind accompanies rainfall.
after: Assess bloom retention and pollination success.
Consider follow-up disease monitoring after wet bloom period.

notes: Rain during bloom disrupts pollination by preventing bee flight.
Wind combined with rain further reduces pollination efficiency.
Bloom stage is the most economically sensitive window for rain-related yield loss.
This playbook focuses on pollination disruption (disease risk handled separately).
